reason: The cited evidence shows that lattice distortion reduces phonon thermal conductivity in HEAs (E3) and that models can estimate minimum/lattice thermal conductivity (E2), but none of the passages provide any support for the key premises about ab initio calculations, machine learning on force-constant features, or the claimed improvement over conventional models. The evidence is only loosely related to the specific predictive approach proposed.
premises: Ab initio phonon calculations can accurately capture phonon dispersions and force-constant fluctuations in HEAs
Machine learning on lattice distortion and force-constant features can rank HEA thermal conductivity
Severe lattice distortions and force-constant fluctuations are the dominant phonon scattering mechanisms in single-phase HEAs
The combined approach will outperform conventional average-parameter models for predicting low κL
Single-phase HEAs with significant configurational entropy exhibit uniform lattice distortions that the approach can model
